answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 45772 Country: India Title: Halal or Haram Question: 1. Is hing (asafoetida) halal for us? 2. When does the Ishraq time end? Answer ID: 45772 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1496/1496/M=12/1434) (1) Hing (asafoetida) is lawful, it is used in meals as well as in medicines, but an excess quantity of it may cause death. (2) The time of Ishraq is till midday, but it is better to perform it in early hours. (Ahsanul Fatawa Vol. 3, p 467) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
